decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.1031. Series context: trend strength 0.997 and seasonal strength 0.0008; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.275); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 35.78.
